name: Yura (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Yura town emblem in white: a ring crossed by horizontal bars, like a rising sun.
history: Municipal flag of Yura, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Yura town emblem — a ring crossed by horizontal bars, like a rising sun
